product_metadata.title: Cosy House Collection Luxury Bamboo Sheets - Blend of Rayon Derived from Bamboo - Cooling & Breathable, Silky Soft, 16-Inch Deep Pockets - 4-Piece Bedding Set - Cal King, Silver
features: SILKY SOFT & BUTTERY SMOOTH - California King 4 piece bed sheet set is made with our unique blend of Rayon derived from Bamboo. Softer than silk and stronger than cotton, our cozy linens will make you feel like you're staying at a luxury resort. Each California King sized bedset includes 1 Fitted Sheet (84" x 72"), 1 Flat Sheet (108" x 102") and 2 Pillowcase(s) (20" x 40"). Cosy’s bedding is comfy, clean, and complete with some seriously soft sheets.

COOL & BREATHABLE - Say bye to night sweats! Our luxury bedding is breathable and lightweight for a cool night's sleep. Rayon derived from Bamboo's temperature regulating and moisture wicking properties help circulate airflow to fend off excess body heat and promote cooling so you wake up feeling refreshed each morning. Whether it's summer or winter, our sheets' thermal-regulating properties help balance your body’s temperature as you sleep for maximum comfort.

SECURE DEEP POCKET FIT - These deep pocket fitted sheets are designed to fit mattresses up to 16 inches thick and are perfect for any mattress type. We’ve even included thick elastic corner straps in our design to ensure your sheets remain snug. That means no more waking up in the middle of the night to adjust your sheets! Also included in this set are pillowcases designed with an envelope enclosure to ensure your pillow stays put.

ULTRA DURABLE & EASY CARE - Our Luxury Sheets stay fresher for longer compared to traditional cotton sheets, so you can finally say goodbye to stinky sheets. To top it off, they’re also odor, fade, stain & wrinkle-resistant. Whether you're looking for easy-to-clean bedsheet sets, or bedding that actually lasts, we've got you covered! Simply throw them in the wash and you’re all set. Machine washable & dryer friendly (cold wash & tumble dry, low heat). No ironing needed.

HIGH QUALITY - These are plush, elegant, hypoallergenic sheets that are kind to your skin and can ward off common non-living allergens! With the look and feel of silk, these lavish sheets are carefully crafted from mindful materials to not only give you peace of mind but to give you a great night’s sleep, too. By combining double-brushed polyester microfiber with Rayon derived from Bamboo, our Cosy sheets offer the highest quality for super affordable prices!

PEACE OF MIND - Shop with confidence. If you don't absolutely love your new Luxury Bed Sheets, we offer a 100% Satisfaction Guarantee paired with World Class customer service. We care about our Cosy community and we are here for you every step of the way!
